## Purpose
Manages document head tags through react-helmet-async: sets the `theme-color` meta based on the applied theme and injects Google Analytics (gtag) scripts when an id is configured. It renders no visible UI.

## Key concepts
- `HeadTagEditor({googleAnalyticsId, appliedTheme})` wraps a `Helmet`.
- `isDarkishTheme` from [[src-utils]] picks `#000000` or `#ffffff`.
- The inline script defines the `gtag` function (the extracted symbol) and runs `gtag('config', id)`; the id is interpolated into script text.

## Gotchas
- Requires a `HelmetProvider` ancestor (react-helmet-async).
